    • getAdditionalPlaceItemIdsList

      List<String> getAdditionalPlaceItemIdsList()
      Additional block item ids that pathfinding may place after exhausting its
built-in disposable building blocks. This is request-scoped and should be
used sparingly for recovery paths that would otherwise leave a bot
stranded.
      repeated string additional_place_item_ids = 8;
      Returns:
      A list containing the additionalPlaceItemIds.
